notes.subject: דשה
notes.gloss: KJV/JPS 'at grass' (דֶּשֶׁא tender grass) vs ASV/BSB 'treading out grain' (from דוש); consonants allow both

notes.subject: ותצהלי
notes.gloss: 'neigh' (of horses, matching אברים as stallions) vs KJV 'bellow' (of bulls); the verb covers both gleam-sound and animal cry

notes.subject: ⟨konji⟩
notes.rationale: אברים is 'mighty ones/stallions' — 'konji' supplied so the neighing makes sense in Slovenian

notes.subject: to Babylon
notes.rationale: second-person feminine address — Babylon personified as a woman

translation: Ker se veselite, ker skipate radosti, o plenilci moje dediščine; ker bunite kakor telička na mladi travi in ržite kakor mogočni ⟨konji⟩.
